company.name: Oshi Health
company.shortDescription: Oshi Health is a digital health platform that provides personalized support and resources for people with digestive health conditions.
company.description: Oshi Health is a virtual-first gastroenterology (GI) clinic that diagnoses, treats and remotely monitors digestive (GI) conditions. Patients work with Oshi Health's integrated care team of gastroenterologists and GI-specialized nurse practitioners, registered dietitians, behavioral psychologists and health coaches to determine the root causes of their symptoms and use a personalized care plan that includes medication, dietary interventions and gut-brain behavioral therapy to get symptoms under control.

productsAndServices.description: A virtual gastrointestinal care service that combines medical, nutrition, and gut-brain support to diagnose, treat, and manage digestive symptoms and conditions.
productsAndServices.name: Oshi Health Virtual Whole-Person GI Care

productsAndServices.description: Virtual evaluation and treatment from gastroenterologists and GI-trained providers, including symptom assessment, diagnosis, medication management, testing, and referrals.
productsAndServices.name: GI Medical Evaluation and Treatment

productsAndServices.description: Personalized nutrition counseling from GI-trained registered dietitians to identify dietary factors, improve nourishment, and manage digestive symptoms and conditions.
productsAndServices.name: GI Nutrition Care

productsAndServices.description: Behavioral support from gut-brain specialists to address the relationship between digestive symptoms, stress, emotions, and nervous-system responses.
productsAndServices.name: Gut-Brain Behavioral Health Care

productsAndServices.description: Digital and administrative support that helps patients manage GI care through virtual appointments, secure messaging, records coordination, referrals, and personalized resources.
productsAndServices.name: Oshi Health Care Coordination and Digital Patient Support

productsAndServices.description: A virtual GI care offering for employers and health plans that provides covered members with coordinated digestive healthcare and population-level support.
productsAndServices.name: Oshi Health for Employers and Health Plans

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series C round raised $60,000,000, or 50.21% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $14,169,206 to $391,773,644, a 27.65x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 84 (-7 over 90 days) and market heat at 70 (-11).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
